midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Primary text, heading strokes, dark borders — the structural color of the system, near-black with a cool blue undertone that matches the brand accent

signature-violet.$description: Signature Violet — Brand accent and primary action — CTA fills, link borders, active states, star ratings, icon highlights; the single chromatic voice in an otherwise achromatic system

signal-red.$description: Signal Red — Red action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

periwinkle-tint.$description: Periwinkle Tint — Lighter violet for nav borders, hover states, and decorative accents — a diluted echo of the brand color for secondary emphasis

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Card border tint and soft highlight surfaces — a very pale violet that adds warmth to otherwise cool gray cards

deep-iris.$description: Deep Iris — Icon fills and secondary link borders — a mid-violet that bridges the brand accent and its lighter tints

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary text and muted body copy — sits between Midnight Ink and the light grays

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, input fields, button text on dark fills — the dominant background across the entire system

fog.$description: Fog — Subtle surface elevation, soft dividers, secondary card backgrounds — the lightest gray for layering without shadows

ash.$description: Ash — Input borders, form field outlines, and standard dividers — the default border color for structural elements

stone.$description: Stone — Shadow base — shadows in the system are cast in dark midnight at 0.2 opacity, not in gray, so this color appears only in button and card shadow tints

steel.$description: Steel — Medium-contrast borders, control outlines, and structural separators. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

lavender-wash.$description: Lavender Wash — Tinted card backgrounds and soft surface lifts — a near-white violet that adds color temperature to elevated areas

roobert.$description: Button text, bold labels, badge copy, and emphasized body — the SemiBold weight adds authority to interactive elements without becoming shouty, keeping buttons compact at 14-16px

sharpgrotesk.$description: Display headings and hero text — the sharper, more condensed grotesque creates clear hierarchy separation from the Roobert body voice, used sparingly so it retains impact at section headers

arial.$description: System fallback for email-like content or legacy form areas — appears minimally, only where third-party content forces it
